patches.value: μH[p] is the native unnormalized Hausdorff measure, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure p = Measure.mkMetric (r↦r^p). Its underlying outer measure is obtained from the metric outer measure construction: at each positive scale infimize the sums of diameter powers of countable covers, empty members costing zero, then take the supremum as the scale tends to zero. Evaluation μH[p](B) is the outer-measure value on any B⊆Z, with no measurability assumption on B. Explicitly, μH[p](B)=sup_{r∈[0,∞],r>0} C_p(r,B), including all extended positive scales.

For an extended metric space Z and B⊆Z, dimH(B)=sup{a∈[0,∞): μH[a](B)=∞}, evaluated in [0,∞] using the Borel measurable structure. The supremum of an empty set of exponents is 0. This is the native Hausdorff dimension with the original critical-exponent convention; the equality of the native measure and the original positive-exponent covering normalization is established in the proof.
